detail.longDescription:
Hello everyone, I’m in the process of setting up long term storage of a large
amount of media files for my family. Since this is stuff that’s rarely accessed,
I don’t need it to be always fully available, and I want to limit the actual
transfer of files to a specific schedule. Since knowing what’s already in
storage is kinda non-trivial, are there any tools out there that allow me to
browse which files are in cold storage, without the actual drives being attached
/ mounted? So only info like file location, name, metadata, perhaps icon, etc.
The transfer part I can manage to automate, as I can think of a few ways of
allowing my users to “stage” pulling and pushing info from and to cold storage,
and having the transfers be done on a fixed schedule like every two weeks or
something. Obviously self-hosted, open source stuff that’s not vibecoded is
preferred. Thanks in advance!
